systems.owner: Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs
systems.tiers: One connected platform for electronic case filing, virtual hearings and tracking of court proceedings, integrating the Judiciary, Ministry of Justice, Law Society, Royal Eswatini Police Service, Anti-Corruption Commission and Correctional Services; launched 2025-08-18, rollout still advancing in May 2026; no stations named

note: The IECMS is described as a court case system that links the police among six justice institutions; the document does not say stations record reports or cases in it, so it gives no station-records fact.
